data.text: All re-review findings fixed in 3b2ce91 (PR #11). (1) Within a subject, events keep time order; an event moves only to right after its own prerequisite (apply after its decide/default, answer after its question, anything else after the item's creating event). Test TestDecideApplySupersede_DImportedEventTimeOrder covers decide, apply, supersede, also with the apply stamped first. (2) The map script runs in an IIFE; TestTwoFragmentsOnOnePage_TLogFixes7 checks the wrapping and, when node is installed, runs two fragments in one global scope (it fails without the IIFE). (3) Links point at the generated commit, else origin/HEAD, else no links; main is never guessed. (4) A pending-version freeze action needs a frozen contract with no open blockers. (5) Lead() reads config.yaml lead:, then the events; no registry. (6) The alias map is keyed by (kind, alias). Cleanups: actionable version errors (add version: N), one git remote get-url per run (Env.Git runner, Env.Remote dropped), hashes the bytes already read, duplicate loopRole removed. Nothing left unfixed. Contract-text updates are in handoff 3.
